steps: Boil and mash potato. Mix with spices. Prepare dough. Fill dough with potato mixture and cook on a hot pan.
Heat oil. Fry garlic and onion. Add vegetables. Add cooked rice and soy sauce. Stir-fry everything together.
Boil pasta. Cook onion and garlic in oil. Add tomatoes and cook into a sauce. Mix with pasta.
Mix paneer and vegetables with yogurt and spices. Marinate. Cook on a pan or grill until lightly browned.
Beat eggs. Add chopped vegetables and spices. Pour into a hot pan and cook both sides.
Place vegetables and cheese between bread slices. Toast until the bread is crisp.
Cook chickpeas until soft. Prepare onion and tomato masala. Add chickpeas and simmer with spices.
Rinse poha. Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. Add onion and peanuts. Mix in poha and cook briefly.
Cook spinach and blend. Prepare onion and tomato masala. Add spinach and paneer. Simmer with spices.
Boil noodles. Stir-fry vegetables. Add noodles and soy sauce. Toss everything together.
Mash cooked potato with onion and chilli. Spread on bread. Add cheese and toast until golden.
Add mango, milk, yogurt and sugar to a blender. Blend until smooth and serve chilled.
Mash banana. Mix with oats, milk and egg. Pour small portions onto a hot pan and cook both sides.
Heat oil. Cook garlic and onion. Add mushrooms and stir-fry. Add soy sauce and pepper.
Cook lentils until soft. Prepare a garlic, onion and cumin tempering. Add it to the cooked lentils.
